questions.question: Which description fits the **TestReport** resource?
options: A summary of information based on the results of executing a TestScript.
A structured set of tests against a FHIR server or client implementation to determine compliance against the FHIR specification.
This resource contains the results of the calculation of a measure; and optionally a reference to the resources involved in that calculation.
This resource provides the definition of a quality measure.
questions.explanation: **TestReport**: A summary of information based on the results of executing a TestScript. The other descriptions belong to **TestScript**, **MeasureReport**, **Measure**.

questions.question: Which resource matches this definition from the specification? “A summary of information based on the results of executing a TestScript.”
questions.explanation: This is the definition of **TestReport** (Specialized › Quality Reporting & Testing).

questions.question: Where does **TestReport** sit in the FHIR R4 resource list?
questions.explanation: **TestReport** is in **Specialized › Quality Reporting & Testing**: Quality measures and their results (Measure, MeasureReport), and scripts and reports for testing FHIR systems (TestScript, TestReport).

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **TestReport** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of TestReport are `status` (1..1), `testScript` (1..1), `result` (1..1). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.

questions.question: Which element of **TestReport** is a **modifier** (?!), so receiving systems must not ignore it?
questions.explanation: Modifier elements of TestReport: `status`. `status`: completed | in-progress | waiting | stopped | entered-in-error. A modifier can change the meaning of the whole resource: for example, a status of `entered-in-error` means the data must not be used.
